headline: Your blood pressure improved, and your doctor asked you to stop amlodipine to see if your ankle swelling goes down.

followUps.title: Stop taking amlodipine
followUps.detail: Stop the amlodipine 10 milligram tablets completely.

followUps.title: Confirm your ramipril dose
followUps.detail: At 2:18 in the recording, the doctor first said “ramipril 20” and corrected it to “ramipril 10 milligrams once a day in the morning.” Listen to that part and confirm the dose with your pharmacist or doctor.

followUps.title: Take leftover amlodipine to the pharmacy
followUps.detail: The pharmacy can dispose of the tablets. Don’t keep them in the cupboard where they could get mixed up with your other pills.

followUps.title: Book a check with Nurse Rivera
followUps.detail: See Nurse Rivera around October 21, 2025, to have your blood pressure and ankles checked.

followUps.title: See Dr. Okafor again
followUps.detail: You said you’re seeing Dr. Okafor again in October 2025. No exact date was mentioned.

instructions.text: Keep checking your blood pressure at home at least 4 or 5 times a week.
Call the clinic if the top number of your blood pressure is over 160 more than twice in one week.
Call the clinic right away if you get short of breath or your swelling gets worse.
Put your feet up when you sit in the evening. You can use a footstool, or lie on the sofa with your feet at hip level for about half an hour.

unchanged.text: Your doctor said your ramipril prescription was not changing. The amount was corrected during the visit, so confirm it with your pharmacist or doctor.
Keep taking atorvastatin 20 milligrams at night.
Keep taking vitamin D 1,000 units a day.
Keep using acetaminophen as needed for your knee.

openQuestions.text: Will your ankle swelling go away after you stop amlodipine?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: Nurse Rivera will check your ankles in about 4 weeks.

openQuestions.text: Will your blood pressure go up after you stop amlodipine?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: You’ll watch your readings at home, and Nurse Rivera will check your blood pressure in about 4 weeks.
